tldr_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.6系列模型與Daybreak網路安全計畫，Meta發布大型AI宣言，AI安全與應用成焦點。
tldr_en: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6 models and Daybreak cybersecurity program; Meta publishes major AI manifesto; AI safety and applications take center stage.

items.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.6系列模型，涵蓋財務與網安領域
items.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6 series models for finance and cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布多個GPT-5.6變體模型，包括專用於金融領域的Sol版本與網路安全專用的Cyber版本。GPT-5.6 Sol協助企業自動化財務分析與報表生成，Cyber版本則透過Daybreak Red平台提供予授權安全研究機構進行漏洞研究與測試。
items.summary_en: OpenAI unveils multiple GPT-5.6 variants including Sol for finance and Cyber for cybersecurity. Sol automates financial analysis and reporting, while Cyber is available through Daybreak Red for authorized vulnerability research and security testing.

items.title_zh: OpenAI暫停Astra開發中的高風險內部活動，提高安全要求
items.title_en: OpenAI pauses high-risk Astra internal activities, raises safety standards
items.summary_zh: OpenAI即將推出的Astra模型已達到準備框架定義的重大資安能力門檻，公司因此提高開發與測試期間的安全要求，並暫停尚未符合新規範的內部活動。此舉反映OpenAI對AI代理自主能力進一步提升帶來的安全風險的謹慎態度。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's forthcoming Astra model has reached critical security capability thresholds, prompting the company to heighten safety requirements and pause non-compliant internal activities. The move reflects OpenAI's cautious approach to risks from AI agents' expanded autonomous capabilities.

items.title_zh: Claude、Gemini與Codex AI代理存在共同信任漏洞
items.title_en: Claude, Gemini, and Codex AI agents share critical trust vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: 資安公司Novee Security發現三套主要AI程式開發代理（Anthropic Claude Code、Google Gemini CLI、OpenAI Codex）在工具權限、沙箱隔離與共享工作區存在信任落差。攻擊者可透過GitHub議題注入惡意內容，導致遠端程式碼執行、機密資料外洩與持續控制。
items.summary_en: Security firm Novee Security identifies trust gaps in three major AI development agents across tool permissions, sandbox isolation, and shared workspaces. Attackers can inject malicious code via GitHub issues, enabling remote code execution, data leaks, and persistent control.

items.title_zh: Meta執行長扎克伯格發布6500字AI宣言，引發行業爭議
items.title_en: Meta CEO Zuckerberg publishes 6,500-word AI manifesto sparking industry debate
items.summary_zh: 馬克·扎克伯格發布題為「未來屬於所有人」的長篇宣言，闡述其對人類與AI共存未來的願景與個人超級智能系統的可能性。宣言引發科技業與評論者廣泛討論，對其AI戰略重塑與開源模型策略的評價不一。
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg publishes "The Future is for Everyone" manifesto outlining his vision for human-AI coexistence and personal superintelligence systems. The 6,500-word essay sparks mixed reactions from industry observers regarding Meta's AI strategy and open-source approach.

items.title_zh: YouTube提高創作者變現門檻，觀看時數要求增加至8000小時
items.title_en: YouTube raises creator monetization thresholds to 8,000 watch hours
items.summary_zh: YouTube自2027年2月1日起，將合作夥伴計畫（YPP）的門檻提高至1000訂閱者加8000小時觀看時數（或20天內短影音200萬次觀看）。此舉大幅提高創作者變現難度，在小型創作者社群引發關注。
items.summary_en: YouTube raises Partner Program requirements to 1,000 subscribers plus 8,000 watch hours (or 20M Shorts views in 90 days) starting February 2027. The significant increase in monetization thresholds affects smaller creators' ability to earn revenue.

items.title_zh: Google推出2026年Pixel新品硬體發表會，手機與穿戴新品亮相
items.title_en: Google hosts 2026 Made by Google event with new Pixel phones and wearables
items.summary_zh: Google將於週三舉行年度Made by Google硬體發表會。已確認推出新款摺疊和直板式Pixel手機，消息並指出將發表新款智慧手錶、AirPods新色，可能還有其他未宣佈的新品。
items.summary_en: Google hosts its annual Made by Google hardware event featuring new slab and foldable Pixel smartphones. Expected announcements include updated smartwatches, new earbud colors, and potentially other unrevealed products.

items.title_zh: 美國伊利諾州通過法律，Linux等作業系統須負責年齡驗證
items.title_en: Illinois passes law requiring operating systems including Linux to verify user age
items.summary_zh: 伊利諾州通過HB5511法案，要求所有作業系統（包括Linux開源系統）實施年齡驗證機制。此舉引發開源社群與科技業廣泛關注，涉及技術可行性與立法適當性的深層爭議。
items.summary_en: Illinois passes HB5511 requiring all operating systems, including open-source Linux, to implement age verification. The law sparks significant debate in tech and open-source communities regarding technical feasibility and legislative appropriateness.

items.title_zh: Amazon支持大型天然氣發電廠，恐成美國最大污染源
items.title_en: Amazon backs massive natural gas plant that may become top U.S. pollution source
items.summary_zh: Amazon為新建資料中心提供資金支持，但該項目涉及美國最大天然氣發電廠之一的建設。此舉與Amazon之前的氣候承諾相悖，引發環保與政策評論者的批評。
items.summary_en: Amazon funds a data center project involving one of the largest natural gas power plants in the U.S., contradicting its climate commitments and sparking environmental criticism.

items.title_zh: Aptoide應用商店首次重返Google Play，挑戰Google壟斷地位
items.title_en: Aptoide becomes first rival app store to return to Google Play in U.S.
items.summary_zh: Aptoide應用商店在停用十多年後首次重返Google Play，成為首個在法院命令下回歸的競爭應用商店。此舉標誌Google在Android開放政策上的重大轉變，允許更多第三方應用商店競爭。
items.summary_en: Aptoide app store returns to Google Play for the first time in over a decade following court-ordered Android changes. The move marks a significant shift in Google's Android openness policy, enabling competing app stores.

items.title_zh: 哥倫比亞西部發生7.4強震，已造成111人喪生
items.title_en: Colombia hit by 7.4 magnitude earthquake, death toll reaches 111
items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞西部發生規模7.4強烈地震，造成至少111人死亡、87人受傷，多座城市建築物倒塌。政府已宣布進入國家緊急狀態，美洲多國承諾提供援助。
items.summary_en: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake strikes western Colombia, killing at least 111 people and injuring 87. Multiple buildings collapse in several cities as the government declares a national emergency with regional aid pledges.

items.title_zh: 微軟計畫9月推出Maia 300 AI晶片，已與台積電洽談產能
items.title_en: Microsoft planning September launch of Maia 300 AI chip with TSMC production talks
items.summary_zh: 美媒報導微軟正計劃最快於9月發表新一代AI晶片Maia 300，並已與台積電洽談明年保有30多萬顆的產能。此舉標誌微軟加速推進自有AI晶片研發的決心。
items.summary_en: Reports indicate Microsoft plans to unveil its Maia 300 AI chip by September and has discussed securing over 300,000 units of production capacity with TSMC for next year, signaling accelerated in-house chip development.

items.title_zh: 特朗普簽署命令限制兒童疫苗，推廣不存在的疫苗
items.title_en: Trump signs order restricting childhood vaccines, promoting non-existent vaccines
items.summary_zh: 美國總統特朗普簽署行政令限制兒童疫苗，並推廣不存在的疫苗產品。該命令包含對MMR疫苗的不實指控，美國兒科學會譴責此舉為「危險」決定。
items.summary_en: President Trump signs an executive order restricting childhood vaccines and promoting non-existent vaccine products. The order includes false claims about MMR vaccines, drawing condemnation from the American Academy of Pediatrics as "dangerous."

items.title_zh: 2026年7月創全球海洋最高溫紀錄，氣候變遷加劇
items.title_en: Global oceans hit record-high July temperatures amid climate change
items.summary_zh: 全球海洋在2026年7月創下歷史最高溫紀錄，部分歸因於厄爾尼諾現象發展。同時西歐野火持續肆虐，氣候變遷的影響加劇全球極端天氣事件。
items.summary_en: Global oceans recorded their hottest July on record, partly driven by developing El Niño conditions, while wildfires continue devastating western Europe amid intensifying climate change impacts.
